name: Legion Pocket Portal: the opened portal takes group members, and only them, to the Blasted Lands (#6240)
contract: Report #6240: using the Legion Pocket Portal (100576) does nothing.

Item 100576 casts Portal: Blasted Lands 966370, a 10 second cast whose portals last 30 seconds and whose two TRANS_DOOR effects place gameobjects 100576 and 100575; its description says it creates a portal teleporting group members who use it to the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
Neither object had a gameobject_template row, so nothing was placed.

The stock portals that do this job, 195141 and 195142, are party-only spellcasters that teleport to -11708.4, -3168, -5.07 on map 0 (their spells carry a level 58 condition); the client spell 966369 Portal Effect: Blasted Lands is the CoA counterpart, a TELEPORT_UNITS to TARGET_DEST_DB with no destination row.
After the item is used, both objects must stand in the world, a group member who uses one must arrive there, and a player outside the group must not.
